parameters.content:
## Shopify Update Pipeline - Update Product (sub-workflow)

UPDATE ONLY. Called by 'Shopify Update Pipeline (GraphQL)' once per flagged row. It is a copy of the update path of 'Process Product': pre-check of image links, field diff, product / variant / metafield / collection / image sync, gallery reorder check, write-back to the sheet.

Nothing here can create a product: a row that is not an update stops at '🛑 Reject: not an update row'.

The existing 'Process Product' workflow is untouched. When this one is proven, the update logic can be removed from the existing one.
